versions.content: Keep runtime of ISR as short as possible General Specification of Basic Software Modules AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 41 of 86 Document ID 578 : AUTOSAR_SWS_ BSWGeneral - AUTOSAR confidential - The runtime of Interrupt Service Routines (ISR) and functions that are running in interrupt cont ext should be kept short. This affects also, for instance, Callback functions which are called from ISRs. Where an ISR is likely to take a long time, an Operating System task should be used instead.
